name: Swahili Scene Text Detection and Recognition Dataset
description: Scene text recognition is essential in many applications, including automated translation, information retrieval, driving assistance, and enhancing accessibility for individuals with visual impairments. Much research has been done to improve the accuracy and performance of scene text detection and recognition models. However, most of this research has been conducted in the most common languages, English and Chinese. There is a significant gap in low-resource languages, especially the Swahili Language. Swahili is widely spoken in East African countries but is still an under-explored language in scene text recognition. No studies have been focused explicitly on Swahili natural scene text detection and recognition, and no dataset for Swahili language scene text detection and recognition is publicly available. We propose a comprehensive dataset of Swahili scene text images and evaluate the dataset on different scene text detection and recognition models. The dataset contains 976 images col
evaluation_method: detection metrics (precision/recall/F1, mAP) and recognition accuracy / edit-distance-based scoring
reputation: A niche but useful low-resource benchmark for Swahili scene text, with limited community adoption due to its recent release and specialized scope.
notes: Small, language-specific dataset; primarily a non-LLM vision benchmark. Performance depends on both detection and OCR quality, and results may not generalize beyond Swahili scene text.
